name: Airtable

auth.keyHelp: Pick the scopes data.records:read and schema.bases:read, then choose which bases the token may see.

tested: mock; real service refused a fake key
notes: Personal access tokens only: the old api_key URL parameter was shut off on 2024-02-01. Bearer header confirmed on the authentication page. GET /meta/whoami needs no scope and returns id (and email only with the user.email:read scope), so 'who' is the user id. List records needs scope data.records:read plus base read-only role; create needs data.records:write plus Base editor role; list bases needs schema.bases:read (up to 1000 per page, paged by offset). A read-only token is possible by granting only read scopes. The base URL https://api.airtable.com/v0 comes from the full endpoint URLs on the list-records and create-records pages; the introduction page does not state it. Rate limit: 5 requests per second per base and 50 per second per token. The create-records page does not state a per-request record cap (the commonly quoted limit of 10 was NOT found in the pages read). The base schema endpoint (tables and fields) is covered by schema.bases:read but its path was not confirmed here, so it is not listed. Official MCP server https://mcp.airtable.com/mcp supports OAuth (recommended, Dynamic Client Registration) and personal access tokens (scopes data.records:read/write, schema.bases:read/write, data.recordComments:read/write, workspacesAndBases:read); the exact header format for passing a PAT to the MCP server is not given on the page.
